scope.forcing: external stage rise 0.005 to 0.300 cm; pulse extension falls back to 0.005 cm

candidate.soil_water_content: quintic smoothstep blend from MvG theta to theta_s over -delta_h < h < 0
candidate.soil_capacity: analytic derivative of the modified theta(h)
candidate.soil_conductivity: Mualem K from regularized saturation, blended to Ks by the same smoothstep
candidate.surface_wet_fraction: quintic smoothstep CDF of normalized external stage over microrelief amplitude
candidate.surface_storage: integral of wet fraction; dS/dH equals wet fraction
candidate.mean_wet_head: surface storage divided by wet fraction

decision: A follow-up test-only central-difference addition of the omitted free-drainage bottom dK/dh term changes the result materially: the delta_h=0.2 cm soil regularization with the inherited continuous piecewise microrelief-storage law completes all six rise/recession refinements at head tolerance 1e-12 with roundoff mass closure. This supersedes the earlier statement that no tested candidate passes all six levels. The run is still synthetic/direct-solver evidence; the derivative correction is not an analytical production implementation and no transaction/Ribasim lifecycle qualification has occurred. Status remains not production-qualified.

followup_head_tolerance_1e9_extended_ref.scope: same D=0.05 cm, delta_h=2 cm joint smooth candidate and 11-stage rise/recession pulse; direct-probe abs/rel head tolerances 1e-9; mass gates unchanged at 1e-10 cm; O0/O2 asserted identical
followup_head_tolerance_1e9_extended_ref.interpretation: Finer refinements fail on recession with residual and head-correction gaps above the configured tolerance; not merely a strict-tolerance convergence artifact.

followup_control_matrix_head_tolerance_1.interpretation: The two isolated controls also fail at some fine refinements, but their failure windows differ. Broad soil regularization alone passes 8 and 16; smooth surface plus near-legacy soil fails from 8 onward; the joint candidate passes through 8 then fails on recession at 16/32. This non-monotone factorial result does not uniquely assign the remaining failure to either law.

followup_transition_width_matrix_head_to.interpretation: At delta_h=0.2 cm the smoothed surface changes the completion pattern strongly versus legacy surface, including passing 8/16/32 where the legacy surface fails 1/2/4/8/16. But the smoothed candidate still fails at refinement 4. At delta_h=0.02 cm the candidate fails at 8 and 32 but passes 16. Thus transition width and time refinement interact; no width here passes all six levels.

followup_bottom_jacobian_counterfactual_.scope: delta_h=0.2 cm regularized soil theta/capacity/K; inherited continuous piecewise microrelief storage, D=0.05 cm; external stage rise/recession; refinements 1/2/4/8/16/32; SwKimpl=0, free drainage SWBOTB=7; O0/O2
followup_bottom_jacobian_counterfactual_.counterfactual: At each Jacobian build, add central finite-difference dK(h_N)/dh_N to the bottom residual-row diagonal; residual and physical law unchanged; generated HeadCalc copy only
followup_bottom_jacobian_counterfactual_.interpretation: The broad near-saturation soil law plus a consistent bottom Jacobian is a promising candidate mechanism; the smoothstep surface hypsometry was not needed in this controlled case. A generated analytic dK/dh implementation subsequently passed its finite-difference oracle at five heads and completed all six levels; it is still not a production source implementation. Source ownership/conflict review, existing top-boundary regressions, and transaction/Ribasim qualification remain open.

followup_analytic_bottom_jacobian_2026_1.scope: same 0.2 cm soil transition, D=0.05 cm rise/recession, inherited microrelief storage, 1e-12 head tolerance, refinements 1/2/4/8/16/32
followup_analytic_bottom_jacobian_2026_1.derivative: Analytic derivative of the generated regularized Mualem K law, including chain rule through effective saturation and transition weight; derivative applied to free-drainage bottom Jacobian in generated HeadCalc copy
followup_analytic_bottom_jacobian_2026_1.interpretation: Analytic derivative counterfactual reproduces the finite-difference convergence result; initial band-only derivative failed, so the tested derivative covers the underlying MvG law outside the regularization band too. This is a research candidate, not an admitted production implementation.

followup_analytic_transition_width_brack.common_scope: legacy integrated microrelief storage, D=0.05 cm, rise/recession stage pulse, head tolerance 1e-12, refinements 1/2/4/8/16/32, analytic generated dK/dh bottom Jacobian, O0/O2
followup_analytic_transition_width_brack.interpretation: Both 0.2 and 2 cm transition settings pass the bounded synthetic pulse/refinement test with the analytic counterfactual. The 0.02 cm implementation fails the near-saturation derivative oracle and is not qualified. No width is physically calibrated by these numerical results.

followup_real_source_opt_in_2026_10_03.api: Optional near_saturation_transition_width_cm defaults to zero in the default MvG initializer and fmr_b110_physical_parameters_t. FMR accepts nonzero values only for SWBOTB=7 and SWKIMPL=0, the only lower-boundary/Jacobian route qualified here, and carries that value into the prepared provider; KSATEXM, elasticity, and unsupported retention modes fail closed. Accepted-step directional derivative routes fail closed while the new law is active.
followup_real_source_opt_in_2026_10_03.driver_scope: Actual source provider and HeadCalc; direct Richards solve; SWKIMPL=0, SWBOTB=7; rise-to-plateau synthetic external-stage profile for the existing 1..4096 result; fixed D=0.05 cm microrelief storage; not the production FMR/Ribasim transaction lifecycle.

default_zero_regression.runner_equivalent: tests/fsi/test_fsi39_b110_ksatexm.f90 compiled locally against the changed provider at O0 and O2

legacy_width_zero_comparator.interpretation: Completion is non-monotonic in timestep size; only 1, 2, and 16 complete all steps in the fixed pulse window.

followup_real_source_opt_in_2026_10_03.jacobian: The provider supplies analytic dK/dh; HeadCalc includes it in the SWKIMPL=0, SWBOTB=7 free-drainage bottom diagonal only when the nonzero-width option is active. Width zero preserves the original branch.
followup_real_source_opt_in_2026_10_03.mass_ownership: The direct probe records soil boundary transfer and surface storage separately; its combined ledger closes to the listed residual. It does not qualify accepted Ribasim publication or transaction replay.

passed_transaction_checks: owner XOR and exactly-once exchange checks
rejected external inundation has no commit or publication
fmr_transaction_characterization.temporal_gate: fmr_serialized_temporal_identity returns zero only for exactly identical full-step and two-half-step B1.10 state; otherwise it returns huge(), so any transient state change is rejected regardless of finite tolerance. TX_TEMPORAL_NONE is rejected by execution-admission preview.
fmr_transaction_characterization.interface_gap: transaction temporal_error receives only full_state and half_state. Top exchange is in model attempt scratch/context, not fmr_b110_physical_state_t. The executor restores checkpoint context before the half branch and captures only the half context; it does not preserve a full-trial context for comparison. Thus the callback cannot compare full-step transfer with composed two-half transfer.
fmr_transaction_characterization.minimum_shared_contract_data: Capture/restore branch-selected endpoint state and integrated signed external transfer for both full and composed two-half trials; define consistent physical scaling for state/transfer accuracy separately from mass closure. No norm or thresholds are selected by this work unit.
fmr_transaction_characterization.shared_prerequisite: integration/sw-rib-top03/TOP03_NUMERICAL_PREREQUISITE.md and TOP03_BOUNDED_INTERVAL_CONTRACT.md assign a qualified BASE transient temporal contract to the numerical/integration regie. This work unit preserves the identity-only policy and does not add a local norm, tolerance, or bypass.
fmr_transaction_characterization.interpretation: The constitutive transition does not solve the end-to-end transaction blocker. Rejection and no-publication behavior pass; accepted inundation coupling is not qualified. The existing shared numerical prerequisite governs the next action.

open_gates: Qualify trial reject, retry, replay, restart, rollback, and accepted-only publication.

Run accepted real SWAP5-Ribasim inundation and recession coupling cases.

followup_real_source_opt_in_2026_10_03.interpretation: The source implementation improves nonlinear completion only for the previously tested rise-to-plateau profile at widths 0.2 and 2 cm and rejects 0.02 cm at a finer derivative check. A separate source-provider rise-and-recession probe now fails at refinement 4096 after the recession ramp returns external head to zero (day 0.1292114), for both widths. Thus the earlier direct-solver evidence does not establish robust source-path recession handling. FMR characterization still rejects transient external inundation at its exact-state temporal gate; this is not production/Ribasim transaction qualification.

followup_exact_base_inundation_refinemen.classification: post-hoc characterization; not a preregistered temporal-acceptance qualification
followup_exact_base_inundation_refinemen.temporal_decision: First two adjacent integrated-transfer error estimates fail joint top-and-bottom contraction for each tested window. At 0.0625 day, top discrepancy contracts but bottom discrepancy increases more than fivefold.
followup_exact_base_inundation_refinemen.interpretation: The regularized law improves nonlinear completion on the exact BASE fixture but still does not justify temporal acceptance or production/Ribasim admission.

followup_source_provider_rise_recession_.driver_scope: Actual source provider and HeadCalc; direct Richards solve; SWKIMPL=0, SWBOTB=7; prescribed external head rises to 0.02 cm, holds, then recedes; not FMR transaction or live Ribasim.

observed_recession_route_change_width_2_.interpretation: The imposed-head route ends as soon as external head falls below previous local ponding, because the provider gate requires external head >= previous ponding. This occurs at the first recession step, before the sill is crossed. Subsequent steps relax local ponding toward zero without maintaining the external-head constraint.

followup_source_provider_rise_recession_.interpretation: Both widths fail at refinement 4096 after the imposed stage has receded to zero (day 0.1292114258, after the ramp ends at 0.126953125). Immediately before the failed solve, external head is 0 cm, ponding and top pressure head are both about 2.85645e-4 cm, and top-node K is 4.75 cm/day. Each run completes refinements 1..2048 and fails at 4096 after 2116 accepted substeps. The failed solve hits 80 Newton iterations; maximum Richards residual is about 0.07 and maximum head trial correction is 1.37315e6 cm. Its trace records 160 within-solve regime changes by evaluation 681. O0/O2 equality holds including the failure. This is evidence of a recession/recession-end failure with extreme Newton branch crossing, not a mass-closure defect.

followup_recession_route_gate_counterfac.scope: Actual production provider and HeadCalc; temporary one-predicate source counterfactual; width 2 cm; same rise/plateau/recession case, solver tolerances, dt levels 1..4096; O0/O2.
followup_recession_route_gate_counterfac.counterfactual_change: external_active requires only external_surface_water_head_supplied and external_head > flooding_sill; removed external_head >= previous_ponding. No source change was persisted.
followup_recession_route_gate_counterfac.interpretation: The prior-ponding gate is causal to loss of imposed-head tracking at recession onset, but deleting it alone is insufficient. It moves the hard disconnect to the sill: at step 2064 external head is 0.0100 cm while local ponding is 0.010625 cm; at step 2065 the stage falls below sill and the imposed-head route ends. Refinement completion remains non-monotonic with two intermediate failures despite the 4096 completion. This is a test-only route-gate counterfactual, not a physical bidirectional exchange law or transaction/Ribasim qualification.
